title: Will Jackson Olson and their partner be eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 28, 2026?
rules: If Jackson Olson and their partner are officially eliminated from Dancing with the Stars Season 35 before Oct 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
The declaration must be made through official program broadcast, website, verified social media, or press releases.
If the season is canceled without declaring eliminations, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Elimination includes being voted off, evicted, knocked out, removed from further contention, voluntary withdrawal, disqualification, or producer removal.
Multiple simultaneous eliminations count.
Initial elimination counts even if the contestant later returns.

Doesn't count for payout
Eliminations immediately reversed in the same episode don't count.
Temporary suspensions, medical holds, or being runner-up in the finale don't count as elimination.

blind.reasoning: Only one episode falls inside the window: the Oct. 27 Horror Movie Night double elimination, where 2 of 10 couples go home based on judges' scores plus combined votes from Weeks 6 and 7. Jackson tied for last with the judges in Week 6 and has been near the bottom all season, which raises his risk above the 20% base rate. But he has survived six weeks thanks to a large social media and Savannah Bananas fan base, which outweighs some of the other low scorers.
blind.falsifier: Jackson Olson and Emma Slater are named as one of the two couples eliminated on the Oct. 27 Horror Movie Night episode (which would make YES correct), or they clearly finish mid-pack and safe.

final.reasoning: The 62.5% price moved my estimate from 30% to 40%, in case traders have information I lack. But the public evidence is that Jackson is one of four couples tied at the bottom of the judges' leaderboard and has survived six weeks on fan votes, which doesn't support 62%, so NO looks like the better bet.
